scope: Publisher access policies only. Original catalog classifications are retained. No item-level suitability, licensing, answer-key or link-availability certification.

gutenberg.org.note: Project Gutenberg provides free reading and downloads without registration. This is the publisher policy. Individual editions and local reuse rights require their own review.

inquirygroup.org.note: Digital Inquiry Group provides free lessons and assessments through a DIG account. The public lesson description may be readable before signing in.

openstax.org.note: OpenStax digital textbooks are free. Most can be read without an account, while selected titles and extra features require one. Supplemental instructor resources require a verified educator account.

phet.colorado.edu.note: PhET describes its simulations as free to students and teachers, with online and downloadable versions. Individual simulations have not been tested on classroom devices.

cemc.uwaterloo.ca.note: CEMC publishes downloadable past contests and separate solutions. Its current listing covers the last ten years. This policy check does not verify this particular PDF or whether a solution accompanies it.

archive.org.note: Internet Archive access varies by item. Borrowing requires an account and depends on availability. Some items permit unrestricted reading or downloads. This item has not been checked individually.
